dev.claim_in_article: “A call seemed to come from an AI agent. But as the conversation went on, the voice was not AI at all. It was a person. Meta had run a test that caused exactly this surprise.”
dev.issue: The article presents a recipient discovering during a call that a person, not AI, was speaking, and says the test caused this surprise. The Ledger verifies that trained contract workers made some Muse calls, but does not establish that recipients experienced this reveal.
dev.explanation: The English version turns the source’s suggestive framing into an asserted event and adds an unverified recipient reaction. This is a changed fact, strengthened certainty, and unsupported new claim.
dev.qualifier_text: “seemed to come from an AI agent”

stage2_results.local_context:
# We Thought It Was AI—But There Was a Person Inside Meta’s Muse

Ring, ring. A call seemed to come from an AI agent. But as the conversation went on, the voice was not AI at all. It was a person.

Meta had run a test that caused exactly this surprise.
stage2_results.rewrite_hint: “A call seemed to come from an AI agent. But as the conversation went on, the voice was not AI at all. It was a person.” 受け手がAIだと思い、会話中に人間だと気づいて驚いたという出来事はLedgerで確認できません。その知覚・驚きを断定せず、「Meta tested having trained human contractors handle some calls placed through Muse」のように、一部の電話を人間の契約スタッフが担当したテストに範囲を絞ってください。参照: MUSE-HC-006。
